{{Top|leg}}
'''Polearm Five''' was the [[Callsign/Legends|call sign]] used by an [[Polearm Five (7 ABY)|unidentified pilot]] who was part of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic's]] [[Polearm Squadron/Legends|Polearm Squadron]]. During the [[Hunt for Zsinj|campaign]] against [[Warlord/Legends|Warlord]] [[Zsinj]], Polearm Five perished at the [[Battle for the Razor's Kiss]] with a [[Turbolaser/Legends|turbolaser]] shot from the [[Iron Fist (Executor-class)|''Iron Fist'']].<ref name="if">''[[X-Wing: Iron Fist]]''</ref>
